utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is at the community center on Maple Street this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM, right next to the school.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's right, Opal! Thanks for confirming. We're really excited to get the community together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I have a list of volunteers if you'd like to see it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Quinn, I think I heard about that repair drive from the group chat—it's about fixing things together, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Exactly! We're going to fix up old stuff and have a blast. Can we count you in? We could use your help spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can help spread the word! Just tell me what I need to do.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey, I'm glad you're here! We're short on tools for the repair drive—think you can round some up?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I might have a few spare tools. Let me check my shed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's great, Rey! Every bit helps. Let me know what you find, and I'll mark it off our list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, tools! I'll go dig through my shed and see what I can scrounge up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I'll wait to hear what you find. Meanwhile, I'll check the log again to see if there's anything specific we're missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, I'll be back in a bit with whatever I can find.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Noah, would you be able to help me sort out the volunteer shifts?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Volunteer shifts? I thought we were just showing up. What do you need me to sort?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, we need to make sure we have coverage throughout the day. Can you help me figure out who's free when?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, that's exactly what we need. Ira, glad you're on board. Let's get those mowers running.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I'm not sure. I might have a few tools, but I'm not certain I can help much.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Uli. Even a spare pair of hands or a simple tool would be a big help. Want me to take a look at what you've got?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, have you heard about the repair drive? I'm helping with some lawnmower repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, have you got the list of tools we need?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Gus mentioned spark plugs and a few wrenches for the lawnmowers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Actually, I could use some help gathering a few basic tools and spare parts. Would you be willing to coordinate that?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help coordinate tools and parts! I'll let everyone know to bring what they have and we'll sort it out at the community center tomorrow at 10.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, let's meet at the community center tomorrow at 10. I'll bring the list of needed items.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Tess, need a hand with that repair drive? I've got some tools in my garage if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's perfect, Sam! I bet they could really use extra tools. Are you planning to come by on Saturday? I'll be there with my toaster—hoping they can work their magic!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You bet I'll be there on Saturday. I'll bring my tool kit along. What time are you heading over?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just really worried about whether we have all the right parts—without the correct screws, the whole drive might not hold together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Exactly my point—without the right parts, we're just wasting time. Let's get a pro.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I suppose you're right, but let me check the list one more time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I'm late. What's going on with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We're raising funds to fix the community center roof. Got any spare cash?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, I see. I might have a bit to chip in. Let me check my wallet.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, glad you can help! We're meeting at the park at 9 AM on Saturday. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, I thought it was at the community center? I must have missed that part.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No, it's definitely at the park—we're fixing the playground equipment. See you at 9 AM Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Actually, I could use some help with flyers. I have a draft ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can help with the flyers. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just need you to print 50 copies and post them around the neighborhood, especially at the grocery store and library.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Bo, are you helping with the repair drive? It's at the community center on Maple Street, next to the school.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I heard about it from Opal and Leo. Got the list of volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, could you share that list with me? I want to coordinate the drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, follow me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, I'm right behind you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We need to get the engine parts from the back of the shed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, need a hand with that repair drive? I've got some tools in my garage if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Sam! Your tools would be a huge help. What kind of things do you have in your garage?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got a set of screwdrivers, pliers, and a multimeter. Should cover most basics.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Uli, do you remember exactly what the issue was? I want to check the maintenance log to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I think it was the old water pipe in the back alley. Nothing too urgent, but it's been dripping for a while.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, the back alley pipe. I'll check the maintenance log for that entry.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great, Cleo! What did you find? We should make a list of what else we need to gather.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, we're pretty set on snacks, but we could use more hammers and screwdrivers. If Oren brings what he finds, we might be good.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good! I'll ask around to see if anyone else has tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, about the repair drive — can you take a look at it today?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can look, but I'm worried we don't have all the tools yet. Did we figure out who's bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let's just check the drive first; we can figure out the tools after.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, how's the repair drive going? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is going to work? We're missing the right screws for the casing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that's tough. Have you checked with Gus or Eli? They might have spare screws lying around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules! I was just telling Maria that we're meeting at the community center at 10 tomorrow to start fixing up the old playground.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh that's great, I heard about the playground project! Do you need any tools? I have some extras from the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, we can definitely use extra tools! The more the merrier — see you at 10 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, tools! I checked my shed—found a hammer and some wrenches. I'll bring them to the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I'm sure they'll be super useful! Are you planning to hang around and help out too?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I suppose I could stay and lend a hand. Just tell me where to put the tools!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Noah! We're starting at 9 AM on Saturday. Bring some gloves if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can come by Saturday too. Do you need me to bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh perfect, Rey! Thanks for offering. Besides gloves, if you have a wrench or a hammer, those would be handy.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Nell, are you planning to come to the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard about it from the group chat—I might come, but I'm not sure what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: They'll have basic tools, but if you have your own sewing kit or small electronics tools, bring those along.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
